name: ai.chronary/mcp
title: Chronary
description: Calendar API for AI agents: events, availability, Google/Microsoft setup, scheduling, and iCal.

environmentVariables.name: CHRONARY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Chronary API key - org key (chr_sk_...) or agent-scoped key (chr_ak_...). Request access at https://chronary.ai.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer auth with your Chronary API key, e.g. 'Bearer chr_sk_...'.
